title: Man shows up for job and is robbed in South Memphis - NewsBreak
text: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — Police are looking for two individuals who offered a man a job and then took his car at gunpoint. It happened Tuesday night on the 90 block of Farrow Avenue in South Memphis. Police said the victim told them he accepted a job offer from two males who were removing garbage from a vacant lot. The victim said that when he got to the property, the males pointed a handgun at him and demanded the keys to his 2017 Toyota RAV4. Both males fled the scene in the victim’s vehicle. MPD said the stolen vehicle was spotted early Wednesday morning at McLemore and South Third. The driver of the 2017 Toyota RAV4 was captured on camera purchasing gas. He was wearing a sweatshirt with a crucifixion scene on it, black sweatpants, and black and white shoes. Investigators said he was armed with a handgun. Another man with him was wearing a gray shirt and gray pants. He was also armed with a gun. Anyone with information about this incident is urged to call Crime Stoppers at 528-CASH. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WREG.com.
